course.title: PostgreSQL — Complete Deep Database Course
course.description: A database-specific, beginner-to-advanced PostgreSQL course covering data modeling, querying, integrity, performance, security, operations and a complete learning-platform database capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the database concepts required to learn the technology properly; no fixed template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Handle transactions or atomic operations where applicable.
Integrate the database with backend APIs.
Build a complete learning-platform data layer.

modules.title: Database Foundations
modules.description: Understand relational databases, tables, rows, columns, keys, schemas and how PostgreSQL stores structured data.

lessons.title: Database Foundations
lessons.description: Understand relational databases, tables, rows, columns, keys, schemas and how PostgreSQL stores structured data.
learningObjectives: Apply it to a realistic learning-platform scenario.

notes.text: Understand relational databases, tables, rows, columns, keys, schemas and how PostgreSQL stores structured data.

Understand database foundations first as a data problem, then learn the database-specific syntax. The goal is to know what the database is doing, why the design works, and what trade-offs appear at scale.
Database Foundations is important when building real applications because database decisions affect correctness, performance, reliability and maintainability.

notes.caption: Teaching diagram for Database Foundations: show the data flow and important database operations.

items: Trace what happens internally at a high level.

notes.code:
CREATE DATABASE learning_platform;
-- Tables will be created inside the database.

items: Identify the data being stored or retrieved.
Change one part and test again.
Using a data model without considering access patterns.
Treating production databases like local development databases.
I can explain Database Foundations in my own words.
I can implement a small example.
I can identify an edge case.
I can explain one performance or reliability consideration.

practicals.title: Guided Practical — Database Foundations
practicals.objective: Apply Database Foundations in a controlled PostgreSQL exercise.

practicals.expectedOutput: A working PostgreSQL exercise demonstrating Database Foundations.
